_comment: WoW Forever patch notes — parsed from foreverchanges.pro/patch-notes by the wowfarsi update agent (agent/README.md). EN source text; the UI is Persian.

entries.prose: Try these changes in the talent tree: Druid, Paladin, Mage, Priest. A hotfix to the October 30 build, first seen on October 30 in the cache the launch realms send, which Blizzard has posted no notes for. It reworks the druid and paladin talent trees and brings in the racial pass announced on October 26. Values that flip between hotfixes can come from differences between the NA and EU realms: in that case this page follows the newer hotfix.

changes.name: The Quick and the Dead
changes.text: This Legacy perk now makes Righteous Fury free too after you are resurrected. Its tooltip does not say so.

changes.name: Reverence
changes.text: Has 2 ranks instead of 3, for the same 30% at the last rank. Moves to row 2.

changes.name: Blessing of Light
changes.text: No longer taught by trainers.

changes.name: Greater Blessing of Light
changes.text: No longer taught by trainers.

changes.name: Spiritual Focus
changes.text: Has 5 ranks instead of 2, for the same 70% at the last rank. Moves to row 1.

changes.name: Improved Seals
changes.text: Has 5 ranks instead of 3, for the same 15% at the last rank.

changes.name: Voice of Truth
changes.text: Leaves the talent tree: trainers teach it at level 20 instead.

changes.name: Holy Power
changes.text: Increases the critical healing bonus of your Holy spells by 10 to 50%, instead of giving Holy Shock and Holy Strike 3 to 15% critical strike chance and your other spells 1 to 5%.

changes.name: Divine Precision
changes.text: Has 2 ranks instead of 3 and no longer needs Holy Shock: up to 8% hit chance with Holy spells instead of 18%, and Silence effects on you up to 20% shorter. Moves to row 4.

changes.name: Light's Vigil
changes.text: Works on friendly targets only: it no longer damages enemies. Its range is 40 yd instead of 20.

changes.name: Oath of Light
changes.text: New talent in row 4, where Voice of Truth was: swear an Oath on an ally for 5 min, and your Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock heal them for more. The server sets the amounts, which the data does not carry yet. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Boundless Light
changes.text: New talent in row 5, after Holy Shock, 2 ranks: up to 30% more critical strike chance for Holy Shock on allies without your Oath of Light. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Illumination
changes.text: Moves from row 4 to row 3, still under Reverence, which now has 2 ranks.

changes.name: Holy Conduit
changes.text: Moves from the Retribution tree to Holy, in the third column of row 3.

changes.name: Divine Strength
changes.text: Moves from the second to the third column of row 1.

changes.name: Purifying Power
changes.text: Moves from row 3 to row 2, in the fourth column.

changes.name: Divine Favor
changes.text: Moves from row 4 to row 3, in the first column.

changes.name: Infusion of Light
changes.text: Moves from the first to the second column of row 4.

changes.name: Consecrated Ground
changes.text: Moves from the third to the first column of row 5.

changes.name: Redoubt
changes.text: Raises your block chance by up to 30% instead of 20%.

changes.name: Improved Righteous Fury
changes.text: Reduces damage taken by up to 9% instead of 6%. Moves to row 4.

changes.name: Righteous Fury
changes.text: Now increases all threat by 33%, and the threat of your Holy attacks by another 90%, instead of 90% for Holy attacks only.

changes.name: Shield Specialization
changes.text: Has 2 ranks instead of 3: 2 ranks give what 3 did, 30% more absorbed and a 100% chance to restore Mana.

changes.name: Seal of Fury
changes.text: Its Judgement taunts the target for 3 sec instead of 4.

changes.name: Salvation
changes.text: No longer taught by trainers.

changes.name: Mass Salvation
changes.text: No longer taught by trainers.

changes.name: Revoke
changes.text: No longer taught by trainers.

changes.name: Swift Judgement
changes.text: Reworked: unleashes a Seal’s Judgement without consuming the Seal, on a cooldown of its own. Now needs Templar’s Bulwark instead of Improved Seal of Fury.

changes.name: Sacred Duty
changes.text: No longer gives Stamina: it now also shortens Forbearance by 5 or 10 sec. Moves to row 2.

changes.name: Iron Creed
changes.text: Has 3 ranks instead of 5: up to 30% more Holy Strike threat instead of 25%, and 6% less damage taken instead of 10%.

changes.name: Stoicism
changes.text: New talent in row 5, 2 ranks: Stun and Charm effects on you are up to 20% shorter. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Shieldsworn
changes.text: New talent in row 7, after Holy Shield: Holy Strike’s cooldown is 4 sec shorter, and Holy Strike hits with your shield, setting off Holy Shield and Shield Specialization without using their charges or cooldowns, and lets you block spells for 6 sec. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: One-Handed Weapon Specialization
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree: it gave up to 10% more damage with one-handed weapons.

changes.name: Improved Seal of Fury
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree.

changes.name: Divine Intellect
changes.text: Moves from the Holy tree to Protection, in the second column of row 1.

changes.name: Holy Shield
changes.text: Moves from row 7 to row 5 and no longer needs Templar’s Bulwark. A new rank 1 is learned at level 30 (75 damage per block, 100 Mana), the old ranks follow at levels 40 and 50 (110 and 153 damage), and the 221 damage rank has no level in the data yet.

changes.name: Toughness
changes.text: Moves from row 1 to row 3, in the fourth column.

changes.name: Templar's Bulwark
changes.text: Moves from row 5 to row 3, in the first column.

changes.name: Improved Hammer of Justice
changes.text: Moves from row 4 to row 3, in the second column.

changes.name: Anticipation
changes.text: Moves from row 2 to row 4, in the third column.

changes.name: Conviction
changes.text: Has 3 ranks instead of 5: up to 6% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, was 5% with melee attacks. Moves to the second column of row 2.

changes.name: Champion of the Light
changes.text: Has 5 ranks instead of 3, still up to 60% of your Intellect as spell damage, and now also takes up to 1 sec off the cast time of Hammer of Wrath.

changes.name: Vindication
changes.text: No longer raises your own attack power by 1 to 3%. It still lowers the target’s.

changes.name: Unsealed Wrath
changes.text: The new name of Twist of Light, reworked, and now after Repentance: your melee attacks store your active Seal for 15 sec, up to 3 times, and an attack with a different Seal consumes them, each stack getting the stored Seal’s normal chance to trigger. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
changes.text: Increases all your physical damage by up to 6% instead of your two-handed weapon damage, and cuts your threat by up to 20% while a two-handed weapon is equipped. Moves to the fourth column of row 4.

changes.name: Vengeance
changes.text: Now needs Seal of Command instead of Sanctified Judgement, and moves to the third column of row 5.

changes.name: Turn Evil
changes.text: New talent in row 5, 2 ranks: Turn Undead casts up to 1 sec faster with up to 10 sec less cooldown, and works on Demons. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Instrument of Law
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree: Champion of the Light takes its Hammer of Wrath cast time and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization its threat cut.

changes.name: Unyielding Faith
changes.text: Moves from the Holy tree to Retribution, in the second column of row 3.

changes.name: Sanctified Judgement
changes.text: Moves from row 3 to row 2, in the third column.

changes.name: Sacred Arbiter
changes.text: Moves from the third to the second column of row 4.

changes.name: Repentance
changes.text: Moves from the third to the second column of row 5.

changes.name: Pathfinding
changes.text: Moves from row 2 to row 3, in the first column.

changes.name: Improved Revive Pet
changes.text: Moves from the fourth to the third column of row 2.

changes.name: Renewed Hope
changes.text: Its tooltip no longer names Binding Heal.

changes.name: Cure Disease
changes.text: Can now be cast in Shadowform.

changes.name: Abolish Disease
changes.text: Can now be cast in Shadowform.

changes.name: Binding Heal
changes.text: Leaves the talent tree: trainers teach rank 1 at level 25 (236 to 284, 155 Mana), and ranks 2 to 6 as before.

changes.name: Holy Binding
changes.text: New talent in row 4, where Binding Heal was: when your Flash Heal heals someone else, you are healed for 50% as much. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Shadow Word: Death
changes.text: Its backlash deals 30% of your maximum health instead of 10%.

changes.name: Arcane Resilience
changes.text: Has 3 ranks instead of 2: up to 75% of your Intellect as Armor, was 50%.

changes.name: Arcane Blast
changes.text: Each cast gives 12% of your Intellect as spell damage instead of 15% and raises its mana cost by 100% instead of 175%. The effect lasts 18 sec instead of 15.

changes.name: Ice Lance
changes.text: Deals 300% more damage to Frozen targets instead of 200%, at every rank.

changes.name: Ice Barrier
changes.text: Increases your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min instead of 3%, and by another 5% instead of 3% while the shield holds.

changes.name: Winter's Chill
changes.text: Each stack makes the target take 20% more damage from your next Cone of Cold instead of 5%.

changes.name: Arctic Reach
changes.text: Now extends the range of Ice Lance too, by 10% or 20%.

changes.name: Ice Lance
changes.text: Ranks 2 to 6 now have the 8 sec cooldown of rank 1 too. Only rank 1, the talent’s, had it.

changes.name: Improved Drains
changes.text: Now covers Drain Mana instead of Wrack: 7 to 20% more Mana drained.

changes.name: Genesis
changes.text: Increases your periodic damage and healing by 2 to 10% instead of 1 to 5%.

changes.name: Moonkin Form
changes.text: Its aura now raises every kind of Critical Strike chance of the party or raid by 3%, not only spell critical strikes.

changes.name: Leader of the Pack
changes.text: Its aura now raises every kind of Critical Strike chance of the party or raid by 3%, spells included, not only melee and ranged.

changes.name: Ferocious Bite
changes.text: A new rank 1 is trained at level 24, 8 levels sooner: 33 to 43 damage with 1 combo point, up to 129 to 139 with 5. The old ranks become ranks 2 to 6.

changes.name: Lacerate
changes.text: Now a talent in row 4, under Savage Fury, where Primal Bite was. The talent teaches a new rank 1 (20 damage over 15 sec), trainers a new rank 2 at level 34, and the old ranks follow as ranks 3 to 5 at levels 42, 50 and 58.

changes.name: Predatory Discipline
changes.text: New talent in row 4, third column: Ferocious Bite no longer spends your extra Energy, but still deals extra damage for it. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Berserk
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree: Primal Bite takes its place in row 7.

changes.name: Improved Shifting Power
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree: it took 4 or 8 sec off the cooldown of Shifting Power, which is now 8 sec.

changes.name: Primal Bite
changes.text: Moves from row 4 to row 7, under Leader of the Pack, so it comes at level 40 instead of 25. It hits harder and has 3 ranks instead of 4, the next two trained at levels 50 and 60: plus 42, 62 and 77 damage, was 26, 38, 59 and 77.

changes.name: Shifting Power
changes.text: Moves from row 4 to row 7, third column, under Predatory Discipline. Its cooldown is 8 sec instead of 16.

changes.name: Furor
changes.text: Moves to the Feral Combat tree, in the third column of row 1, where Heart of the Wild was.

changes.name: Predatory Strikes
changes.text: Moves from the third to the first column of row 4.

changes.name: Rend and Tear
changes.text: Moves from the third to the first column of row 6, still under Predatory Strikes.

changes.name: Natural Reaction
changes.text: Moves from the first to the fourth column of row 6.

changes.name: Naturalist
changes.text: Increases all damage you deal by 2 to 10% instead of 1 to 5%, and now cuts the cast time of Wild Growth by 0.1 to 0.5 sec too, as it does Healing Touch’s.

changes.name: Wild Growth
changes.text: Has a 3 sec cast instead of being instant. Naturalist can bring it down to 2.5 sec.

changes.name: Bloom
changes.text: New talent in row 3, where Gift of the Earthmother was: when your Rejuvenation or Regrowth runs out, the target is healed for 100% of your Spirit, or 50% if it was dispelled. Not yet translated in the game.

changes.name: Gift of the Earthmother
changes.text: Removed from the talent tree: it took 0.5 sec off the global cooldown of Rejuvenation, Swiftmend and Wild Growth. Bloom takes its place.

changes.name: Heart of the Wild
changes.text: Moves to the Restoration tree, in the third column of row 1, where Furor was.

changes.name: Reflection
changes.text: Moves from row 3 to row 2, where Subtlety was.

changes.name: Subtlety
changes.text: Moves from row 2 to row 3, where Reflection was.

changes.name: Swiftmend
changes.text: Its tooltip now says it needs your own Rejuvenation or Regrowth and consumes the one it uses. Only the wording changed.

changes.name: The Human Spirit
changes.text: Raises Spirit by 10% instead of 5%, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Ruthless
changes.text: Gives 1% critical strike chance instead of 2%, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Savage
changes.text: Replaced by Command: Hunter and Warlock pets deal 5% more damage, instead of 1% critical strike chance, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Earth Fury
changes.text: Replaced by Artisan’s Precision: 1% hit chance with spells and attacks instead of 2% more critical damage and healing, as announced for launch. Find Treasure now also says it sometimes increases the treasure found.

changes.name: Touch of the Grave
changes.text: Its internal cooldown is 15 sec instead of 25, for casters and for Paladins, Rogues and Warriors alike.

changes.name: Plainsrunning
changes.text: Each stack gives 2% movement speed instead of 1%, up to 60% instead of 30%, and it no longer adds mounted speed, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Endurance
changes.text: Only the 5% Health stays: the 2% critical damage and healing bonus is gone, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Berserking
changes.text: Lasts 15 sec instead of 10.

changes.name: Wind Blessed
changes.text: Gives 2% haste instead of 3%, as announced for launch.

changes.name: Read Leyline
changes.text: Raises Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. At a leyline you become Attuned, which doubles it, for 15 min in the game data, where Blizzard announced 1 hour.

changes.name: Skysight
changes.text: Gives 15% movement speed for 30 sec. At an elemental convergence you become Charged, which doubles it, for 15 min in the game data, where Blizzard announced 1 hour.

entries.prose: The October 30 build puts the server’s hotfixes of October 27 to 29 into the client files: the mage trees’ rework, Ice Lance’s 8 sec cooldown, Blood Fury’s 2 min cooldown and Revenge’s attack power. The Adventurer’s Tent is a cosmetic again. None of this is confirmed: the build came while the realms are closed before launch, Blizzard has posted no notes for it, and nothing can be checked in game yet. Warrior Items1 changed items One item reads differently: the Adventurer’s Tent summons a miniature tent for 15 min with a 15 min cooldown, as on the first October 28 build, instead of a rested tent by a campfire with a 1 hour cooldown.

changes.name: Revenge
changes.text: Deals (138 + 22.5% of attack power) to (168 + 22.5% of attack power) damage at rank 6 instead of 138 to 168, and every rank adds 22.5% of attack power.

entries.prose: A hotfix to the October 28 build, first seen on October 28 in the cache the launch realms send, which Blizzard’s notes do not mention: Aspect of the Hawk and Trueshot Aura give about half their ranged attack power, Blood Fury’s 2 min cooldown announced for launch is in the server’s data, the roots of Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite share one diminishing returns group, and paladins still learn Righteous Fury at level 10. The same data carries the spells of the 2008 zombie plague event, the infection, the zombies’ abilities and the cure, with no event announced.

changes.name: Improved Hamstring
changes.text: Its root now shares one diminishing returns group with the other talent roots: Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite.

changes.name: Aspect of the Hawk
changes.text: Gives 15, 22, 30, 38 and 47 ranged attack power by rank instead of 20, 35, 50, 70 and 90.

changes.name: Trueshot Aura
changes.text: Gives 15, 22, 30 and 40 ranged attack power by rank instead of 30, 40, 50 and 75.

changes.name: Counterattack
changes.text: Its root now shares one diminishing returns group with the other talent roots: Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite.

changes.name: Entrapment
changes.text: Its root now shares one diminishing returns group with the other talent roots: Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite.

changes.name: Improved Wing Clip
changes.text: Its root now shares one diminishing returns group with the other talent roots: Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite.

changes.name: Frostbite
changes.text: Its root now shares one diminishing returns group with the other talent roots: Entrapment, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip, Improved Hamstring and Frostbite.

changes.name: Blood Fury
changes.text: Its cooldown is 2 min instead of 3 min: the server sends the value announced for launch on October 27.

entries.prose: A build of October 28 that changes only model files: 2 of 137 tables differ from the October 27 build, both creature models, and nothing a page reads. Blizzard has posted no notes for it. The first hotfixes of the launch realms, seen the same night, are below.

None of this is confirmed: the build came while the realms are closed before launch, Blizzard has posted no notes for it, and nothing can be checked in game yet. Check out these changes in the talent planner. Items4 changed items Four items read differently. The Adventurer’s Tent changes in the client files. The other three come from the server’s data: the Ultralight Goblin Glider has a 5 min cooldown (was 3 min), Elixir of Wisdom gives 3 Intellect for 30 min (was 6 for 1 hour), and Corrupted Gemstone requires level 60.

changes.name: Frost Blast
changes.text: Removed from the spellbook. The spell is technically still in the game but can no longer be trained. Take this change with a grain of salt.

changes.name: Arcane Focus
changes.text: Removed from the Arcane tree: it gave 1 to 5% hit chance with Arcane spells. Precision, in the Frost tree, now gives hit chance with all spells.

changes.name: Arcane Resilience
changes.text: Moves from row 2 to row 1, in the third column.

changes.name: Missile Barrage
changes.text: Moves from row 1 to row 2.

changes.name: Improved Channeling
changes.text: Moves from the third to the second column of row 1.

changes.name: Accelerant
changes.text: Was Improved Fireball, and now also cuts the cast time of Arcane Wrath by 0.1 to 0.5 sec, as it does for Fireball and Frostfire Bolt.

changes.name: Incineration
changes.text: Has 5 ranks instead of 3: up to 10% more critical strike chance for Fire Blast, Ice Lance, Arcane Blast and Scorch (was 6%).

changes.name: Critical Mass
changes.text: Has 3 ranks instead of 5: up to 6% more critical strike chance for Fire spells (was 10%).

changes.name: Improved Fire Blast
changes.text: Moves from row 1 to row 3, in the fourth column.

changes.name: Precision
changes.text: Was Elemental Precision: its 2/4/6% hit chance now covers all spells, not only Frost and Fire spells.

changes.name: Ice Lance
changes.text: Now has an 8 sec cooldown.

entries.prose: Read from the client, Blizzard having posted no notes for it: the server hotfixes of October 16 to 23 are now in the client itself, Eureka!’s tooltip now says its 8 sec, and no talent, class spell or item reads differently. The racial pass Blizzard announced for launch is not in it. No item reads differently: the build writes the October hotfixes into the client.

changes.name: Eureka!
changes.text: Its tooltip now says the 8 sec the October 15 update gave it.Not in Blizzard’s notes, found in the game.

entries.prose: Blizzard’s notes of October 26 announce a last pass on the racials for launch: role racials come back where a generic one had replaced them, weapon specializations stay out, and some passives are tuned. These changes are in no client yet. The lines below say what changes at launch, and the Races page shows them under each racial.

changes.name: The Human Spirit
changes.text: Raises Spirit by 10% (was 5%).

changes.name: Ruthless
changes.text: Gives 1% critical strike chance (was 2%).

changes.name: Blood Fury
changes.text: Its cooldown is 2 min (was 3 min).

changes.name: Savage
changes.text: Removed. Command comes back: Hunter and Warlock pets deal 5% more damage.

changes.name: Earth Fury
changes.text: Removed. In its place, Artisan’s Precision gives 1% hit chance with spells and attacks.

changes.name: Touch of the Grave
changes.text: Its internal cooldown is 15 sec (was 25 sec).

changes.name: Endurance
changes.text: Only the 5% Health stays. The 2% critical damage and healing bonus is gone.

changes.name: Plainsrunning
changes.text: Each stack gives 2% movement speed (was 1%), up to 60% (was 30%). It no longer adds mounted speed.

changes.name: Berserking
changes.text: Lasts 15 sec (was 10 sec).

changes.name: Wind Blessed
changes.text: Gives 2% haste (was 3%).

changes.name: Read Leyline
changes.text: Raises Health and Mana regeneration by 50% (was 100%), for 15 sec. Read at a leyline, it also makes you Attuned for 1 hour, and the bonus is 100% while Attuned. Attuned survives death and ends when you enter a raid. It cannot be used under Innervate, which replaces it.

changes.name: Skysight
changes.text: Gives 15% movement speed (was 10%), for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence, it also makes you Charged for 1 hour, and the bonus is 30% while Charged. Charged survives death and ends when you enter a raid.

entries.prose: A hotfix to the October 22 build, first seen on October 23, which Blizzard’s notes do not mention: paladins learn Righteous Fury at level 10 instead of 16.

changes.name: Righteous Fury
changes.text: Learned at level 10 instead of 16.

entries.prose: A hotfix to the October 16 build, first seen on October 22, which Blizzard’s notes do not mention: 127 items for the beta only, copies of Molten Core’s loot and its legendary weapons at item level 30 that need level 1, the nine Tier 1 sets with Classic’s bonuses, and elixirs, one of which triples experience for an hour. They say nothing about Molten Core on the live realms. The beta closed on October 23, and Blizzard says they will not be in WoW Forever after launch.
The beta moved to the build the live game’s stress test used on October 21. Its game data is the same as the October 16 build’s: talents, spells and items did not change.

A hotfix to the October 16 build, first seen on October 21, which Blizzard’s notes do not mention: rank 4 of Hunter’s Mark gives twice the ranged attack power it did, and rank 3 of Lava Burst gains 20% from Flame Shock, like the other ranks.

changes.name: Hunter's Mark
changes.text: Rank 4 gives 143 ranged attack power instead of 71.

changes.name: Lava Burst
changes.text: Rank 3 deals 20% more damage to a target with Flame Shock instead of 54%, like the other ranks.

entries.prose: A hotfix to the October 16 build, first seen on October 20, which Blizzard’s notes do not mention: the mage loses Piercing Ice, Elemental Precision gives 2% hit a rank, and Ice Barrier, Frost Ward and Frost Warding get stronger.

changes.name: Elemental Precision
changes.text: 3 ranks of 2% hit each, up to 6% (was 5 ranks of 1%).

changes.name: Ice Barrier
changes.text: Absorbs 10% more (493 instead of 448 at rank 1) and raises your Frost damage by 3% for 1 min, 3% more while the shield holds.

changes.name: Frost Ward
changes.text: Absorbs 10% more (178 instead of 162 at rank 1), plus 10% of your Frost spell power.

changes.name: Frost Warding
changes.text: Also raises what your Ice Barrier and Frost Ward absorb by 10 or 20%. Frost Ward’s chance now negates the spell instead of reflecting it.

changes.name: Piercing Ice
changes.text: Gone from the Frost tree: it gave 2/4/6% more Frost damage.

changes.name: Frost Channeling
changes.text: Moves from the second to the first column of row 3.

changes.name: Improved Blizzard
changes.text: Moves from the fourth to the second column of row 3.

entries.prose: A hotfix to the October 16 build, in the game by October 18, which Blizzard's notes do not mention: the first rank of Holy Fire deals a little less damage.

changes.name: Holy Fire
changes.text: Rank 1 deals 53 to 65 instead of 57 to 70.

entries.prose: A small client update. It only adds cosmetic items whose source Blizzard has not given yet: three mounts (Verdant Sea Turtle, Crimson Rooster, Spectral Wolf Pack), three companions (Blossoming Ancient, Gill'el, Pinky), two transmog sets (Gilded Blademaster's Armor, Stillwater Fisher Attire) and Adventurer's Tent, a toy that changes the look of your Camp Tent. Talents, spells and the other items did not change.
